variants.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a very refined photorealistic industrial design concept board for Korean tea lifestyle brand CHARIM, 차림, by Million Routines. Landscape high resolution, three intentional panels: a large left panel 60% width with the entire coordinated tea collection neatly arranged outside its open fitted presentation box; upper right macro photograph of exactly two tea cups with matching saucers, showing fine material details; lower right packaging closed with tea pouch, folded ritual guide and small conversation cards neatly arranged. No floating objects. Editorial studio product photography, realistic scale and subtle shadows, meticulous elegant material detail, generous whitespace, premium contemporary Korean design, no excessive ornament. Each full set includes exactly one small side-handle teapot, two handleless cups, two matching saucers, one pouring cooling bowl with spout, one shallow tea tray, folded tea cloth, sealed tea pouch, folded guide, two conversation cards and coordinated rigid gift box with believable fitted insert. Optional diary is NOT in the kit. The provided image is only a logo reference: use its simple five rounded petal outline and center dot as a very small signature on cups and stationery. Brand wordmark only 'CHARIM' in delicate refined type; no other text or captions. All cup rims and interiors are plain food-contact ceramic; iridescent accents confined to outside base and packaging. Product concept, not a manufacturing blueprint. Direction YEOBAEK / quiet porcelain. Airy soft-white background. Pure soft-white baekja glazed pottery, round gently swelling tea cups with fine feet, subtly flattened spherical teapot, round white saucers. Hairline celadon glaze ring around each external foot, tiny dark flower. Low pale ash oval tray, mist-celadon linen tea cloth. Tall ivory paper tea pouch with tiny black wordmark. Offwhite textured rigid lift-off-lid box with a narrow pale celadon paper bellyband, blind embossed flower, ivory molded paper compartments. One small silver-pearl flower detail on the band only. Restrained, soft, gallery-like, accessible premium simplicity.
